To align all nitrite treatment converted reads (A to G and C to T mutations) to reference genome, FASTQ reads and FASTA reference were converted to AT-only format (convert all purine (A/G) to A and all pyrimidine (C/T) to T). Converted FASTQ reads were aligned to converted reference using Bowtie2 (v2.3.5.1) [ 46 ].

NM (number of mismatches between the sequence and reference) and MD (string encoding mismatched reference bases) tags in SAM files were recalculated using Samtools (1.9) [ 47 ] calmd command to obtain mutation pattern of original reads.

specification.comparison_metric: The observed AUC computed by the solver from the NT-seq data is compared to the reported AUC value.
specification.numerical_agreement_criterion: Performance metrics on the identical split: the AUC must match the reported value within the displayed rounding bin (three decimal places).
specification.specification_gaps: The exact threshold for calling 6mA sites to compute the ROC curve is not specified; the method for handling positions with coverage ≤25× is not detailed; the exact version of the H. pylori JP26 reference genome is not given in the main text.
specification.alternatives_considered: Other candidate targets included the AUC for 4mC (0.948) and 5mC (0.832), but the 6mA AUC is the first reported in the text and is the primary performance metric for the method's main application; the F1 scores for DIP-NT-seq (0.843) were also considered but are secondary comparisons.
